name: location
description: Settlements, wilderness sites, and adventure spaces
entries: A cliffside city connected by hanging bridges, where buildings migrate up or down according to their owners' social status.
A village built inside the rib cage of an ancient giant whose bones hum before storms.
A forest of white trees that records nearby conversations and whispers them back years later.
An inn standing at a different crossroads each dawn, staffed by people who cannot leave it.
A flooded library where waterproof books swim in schools and librarians navigate by narrow boats.
A volcanic monastery whose bells suppress the creature sleeping beneath the mountain.
A market carved into a petrified dragon, with premium stalls located dangerously close to its still-warm heart.
A battlefield covered in red flowers that bloom into ghostly soldiers whenever blood is spilled.
A town where every home has two front doors: one for the living and one nobody opens after sunset.
A palace built upside down beneath a natural stone arch, reached by gravity-shifting stairs.
A desert of black glass crossed by ships on runners when moonlight makes the surface flow like water.
A sleepy fishing port where the lighthouse beam reveals invisible islands for a few seconds each night.
A colossal abandoned observatory whose rotating rooms now house rival communities.
A cheerful orchard growing fruit that temporarily grants memories from whoever is buried beneath each tree.
A mining settlement surrounding a bottomless vertical shaft from which warm wind and distant music rise.
A ruined temple shared by six minor gods who divide worshippers through an elaborate weekly schedule.
A bridge-city spanning a canyon so deep that falling objects return from the sky several days later.
A marsh filled with stone statues that change position whenever nobody is speaking.
A traveling fair whose tents contain much larger landscapes and whose exit occasionally leads somewhere new.
An underground sea lit by luminous fungi, with a single locked tower emerging from its center.
A fortified border town where both neighboring kingdoms claim ownership but neither remembers why it matters.
A frozen garden preserved around an eternal summer pavilion occupied by one very lonely noble.
A maze-like archive where records rewrite the memories of readers to match official history.
A canyon filled with enormous wind chimes that control weather according to which paths travelers take.
A city built on the shell of a migrating giant snail, currently approaching a border its citizens cannot cross.
A cemetery where ghosts run shops selling lost objects, unfinished apologies, and unreliable directions.
A peaceful crater lake hiding the rooftops of a perfectly preserved town beneath its clear water.
A castle slowly turning to salt while its rulers deny anything is wrong.
A roadside shrine surrounded by thousands of keys, none of which fit its only visible lock.
A circular valley where travelers meet versions of themselves who chose different roads.
